candidates.name: Refeeding syndrome
support_spans: He was diagnosed with severe malnutrition and received blood transfusion; parenteral nutrition (500 kcal/day); fluids; electrolyte, trace-element, and multivitamin supplementation (including daily thiamine 100 mg IV).
Then he acutely developed profound fatigue and flaccid weakness of all four limbs.
repeat labs showed a phosphate level of 0.05 mmol/L
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and lab results are consistent with refeeding syndrome, which occurs when a malnourished individual is reintroduced to nutrition too quickly.
